answer: Locks are recorded in trellis, expire in crystal, and nebula lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 179 aliases therefore needs 19 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 121 dollars in locked collateral and another 7 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
